alias: Living room motion lights off when TV is on
description: Cuts power to the living room's motion-sensing lights once the TV draws 30 W or more for 5 s (owner, 2026-10-23), so watching TV doesn't keep setting them off. They stay off until the TV is under 5 W (the pair). From 2026-10-19 to 23 the TV read 0 W in standby and 34-91 W while on, dipping to 21 W for up to 5 s, and was never between 5 and 30 W for 30 s or more, so the gap between the thresholds keeps the lights from flapping. Also re-checks on HA start, on automation reload and when the lights plug comes back online. Pair: living_room_motion_lights_on_when_tv_off. Source: tools/ha/automations in the HomeAssistant repo.
